Acres 2 Disturbed - As discussed previously under Low Level Development, the acreage disturbed by mining operations upon Tracts II and III equals 32.2 acres and 17.5 acres respectively per million tons of coal. At the maximum production rate of 26 million tons per year approximately 258 acres on Tract II and 315 acres on Tract III would be disturbed annually. Tract II coal contains less two seam coal than tract III which necessitates a greater amount of acreage being disturbed upon Tract II.

Acreage Reclaimed - The amount of acreage reclaimed yearly is equal to the amount disturbed yearly with a two year lag time.
Associated Facilities - The present handling facilities now existent on Tract III are adequate for processing and shipping the 18 million tons of coal projected to be mined annually from Tract III at the high level of development.
